etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Latin anomalia, from Ancient Greek ἀνωμαλία (anōmalía, “irregularity, anomaly”), from ἀνώμαλος (anṓmalos, “irregular, uneven”), negating the meaning of ὁμαλός (homalós, “even”), from ὁμός (homós, “same”).
senses: A deviation from a rule or from what is regarded as normal; an outlier.
Something or someone that is strange or unusual.
